name: Apex Logics — EdTech & CareerTech Intelligence Suite

tools.title: Total Compensation Suite
tools.data_vintage: 2026 est. federal brackets · 8-tier state effective rates · FICA SS $176,100 base · Black-Scholes (Abramowitz-Stegun) for options
tools.description: Model total compensation across base, bonus, equity, and benefits for up to four offers or scenarios.

tools.title: Credential ROI Suite
tools.data_vintage: BLS OEWS May 2023 (16 SOC codes) · CIRR/SwitchUp 2023 bootcamp benchmarks · NCES IPEDS 2022-23 tuition tiers · Q4 2024 exam fee schedules (15 certifications)
tools.description: Calculate the NPV and payback period of professional certifications against career earnings uplift.

tools.title: Human Capital Engine
tools.data_vintage: Tab A: Q4 2024 cert fees + BLS OEWS May 2023 (15 certs). Tab B: WEF 2025, McKinsey 2021, IBM 2024 (8 industries, 44 skill domains).
tools.description: Quantify lifetime economic value of human capital across education, career path, and retirement scenarios.

tools.title: Geo-Fiscal Arbitrage Simulator
tools.data_vintage: 70-metro CoL index (C2ER/Numbeo est. 2025-26) · 8-tier state effective rates · category weights: housing 30%, food 14%, healthcare 10%, transport 12%, misc 34%
tools.description: Model income equivalency and net financial impact of relocating across 70 metros with state tax and cost-of-living adjustment.

tools.title: Education Savings Projector
tools.data_vintage: IRS Pub. 970 (2025) · State 529 rules Jan 2026 · NCES IPEDS 2023-24 · SECURE 2.0 Act
regulatory_citations: NCES IPEDS 2023-24 average COA by institution type
tools.description: Project 529 growth, state tax deductions, and college cost coverage across contribution and market scenarios.

tools.title: Career Resilience Engine
tools.data_vintage: Frey & Osborne (2013) Oxford Martin Working Paper — 65 SOC-keyed occupations · LinkedIn Skills on the Rise 2025 (15 fastest-growing US skills) · WEF Future of Jobs Report 2025 (10 fastest-declining skills)
tools.description: Score automation-displacement risk by occupation and model the ROI of upskilling or reskilling investments.

tools.title: Workforce Board ROI Report Generator
tools.data_vintage: DOL ETA WIOA PY 2023 national average negotiated performance targets (5 indicators, 3 program types) · BLS QCEW Q3 2023 private-sector average annual wages (12 sectors).
regulatory_citations: U.S. Department of Labor, Employment and Training Administration — WIOA Performance Accountability, PY 2023
Workforce Innovation and Opportunity Act (WIOA), Public Law 113-128, July 2014
DOL ETA WIOA Participant Individual Record Layout (PIRL) — ETA Form 9173
DOL ETA TEGL 10-16 — WIOA Common Performance Reporting
WIA/WIOA Performance Indicators — 20 CFR Part 677 (Final Rule, August 2016)
Bureau of Labor Statistics — Quarterly Census of Employment and Wages (QCEW), Q3 2023
IMPAQ International — Net Impact and Benefit-Cost Analyses of Labor Exchange Services, 2013
tools.description: Generate a WIOA-aligned ROI report for workforce development programs using credential and earnings outcome data.

tools.title: Career Transition Suite
tools.data_vintage: User-entered inputs only — no embedded reference data
tools.description: Model the financial cost and break-even timeline of switching careers or industries.

tools.title: Visa Strategy Navigator
tools.data_vintage: USCIS FY2025-26 approval rates · DOS Visa Bulletin GC backlog estimates · 7 visa pathway scoring rubric
tools.description: Map US visa pathways and historical approval rates for your occupation, nationality, and career timeline.

tools.title: Professional License Reciprocity Checker
tools.data_vintage: eNLC 2026 (37 states) · IMLC 2026 (37 states) · NASBA SE (all 54) · NCEES comity (all 50+DC) · NASDTEC (all 50+DC) · ARELLO bilateral pairs 2025
tools.description: Check reciprocity and endorsement pathways for licensed professions across all 50 states.

tools.title: Apprenticeship & Earn-and-Learn Matcher
tools.data_vintage: DOL RAPIDS Program Year 2023 · BLS OEWS May 2023
regulatory_citations: DOL RAPIDS Registered Apprenticeship Data, Program Year 2023
tools.description: Identify apprenticeship programs by occupation and state with wage progression and credential outcome data.

tools.title: Scholarship ROI Tracker
tools.data_vintage: 2024-25 Federal Pell Grant schedule (max $7,395, SAI cutoff $6,206) · Direct Loan rate 6.53%
tools.description: Calculate net ROI of scholarship applications by award value, time invested, and estimated win probability.

tools.title: Student Loan Repayment Optimizer
tools.data_vintage: Federal repayment plan formulas 2026 · FPL est. 2026 · PSLF rules studentaid.gov
tools.description: Compare federal repayment plans—IDR, PSLF, standard—by monthly payment, total cost, and forgiveness outcome.

tools.title: FAFSA SAI Simulator
tools.data_vintage: 2026-27 award year (Federal Register 2025-10243)
tools.description: Estimate your Student Aid Index from income, assets, and household data under current FAFSA methodology.

tools.title: CPD / CPE Credit Tracker
tools.data_vintage: User-driven — no embedded reference data. Requirement figures per published 2024 standards.
tools.description: Track continuing education credits against license renewal requirements by jurisdiction and credential type.

tools.title: Exam Cost & Timeline Planner
tools.data_vintage: Q4 2024 — 32 exam fee schedules from 14 official sources
regulatory_citations: PMI PMP and CAPM fee schedule, Q4 2024
CFA Institute exam fee schedule, Q4 2024
NASBA CPA section fee schedule, Q4 2024
NCBE bar exam fee schedule, Q4 2024
GMAC GMAT Focus Edition fee, Q4 2024
ETS GRE General Test fee, Q4 2024
tools.description: Model total cost and study timeline for 32 professional exams including fees, prep costs, and retake probability.

tools.title: Freelance / 1099 Total Cost Calculator
tools.data_vintage: 2026 est. federal brackets · IRS SE tax rules · IRS mileage rate $0.70/mile 2026 est. · SEP-IRA limit $70K
tools.description: Convert 1099 freelance rates to W-2 equivalents accounting for SE tax, benefits, and overhead costs.

tools.title: Benefits Open Enrollment Optimizer
tools.data_vintage: 2025 IRS limits: HSA self $4,300 · HSA family $8,550 · FSA $3,300 · 401(k) $23,500 (IRS Rev. Proc. 2024-25)
tools.description: Compare health, HSA, FSA, and ancillary benefit elections by total annual cost and tax savings.

tools.title: Separation Package Analyzer
tools.data_vintage: IRS Publication 15-T (2024) · IRS Rev. Proc. 2023-34 · 2024 FICA wage base $168,600
tools.description: Evaluate severance packages by cash value, COBRA cost, non-compete terms, and negotiation leverage.

tools.title: Offer Negotiation Suite
tools.description: Model multi-variable offer negotiations with counteroffer impact on total 3-year compensation.

tools.title: Graduate School ROI Comparator
tools.data_vintage: NCES IPEDS 2023-24 · BLS OEWS May 2023 · MBA Employment Reports 2023
tools.description: Compare graduate programs by tuition, opportunity cost, earnings uplift, and NPV break-even timeline.

tools.title: Job Search ROI Tracker
tools.description: Track job search channels by application volume, conversion rates, and time-to-offer ROI.

tools.title: Career Break & Reentry Cost Engine
tools.data_vintage: Tab 1: user-entered only. Tab 2: SHRM 2024 · BLS OEWS May 2023 · CFA Institute 2024 · NALP 2024 · IEEE 2024 · AGC 2024
tools.description: Quantify the total financial cost of a career gap including forgone income, benefit loss, and reentry timeline.

tools.title: MBA Program Fit & ROI Ranker
tools.description: Compare up to 4 MBA programs by COA, opportunity cost, post-MBA salary by specialization, payback, and NPV. 40+ programs. AP2 inbound from AL-26; outbound to AL-30.

tools.title: Test Prep Investment Analyzer
tools.description: ROI of test prep for GMAT/GRE/TOEFL/IELTS/LSAT/MCAT. Score gap + prep cost vs. admissions tier shift and scholarship lift. 2-tab tool.

tools.title: International Student Cost Modeler
tools.description: F-1 visa costs, OPT/STEM OPT earnings window, H-1B rates FY2020-24, non-US program comparison. 2-tab tool. Legal disclaimer required.

tools.title: Parent College ROI Planner
tools.description: 529 projection, SAI/EFC asset impact, COA by school tier, loan vs. gift split. AP2 inbound from AL-17. 2-tab tool.

tools.title: Equity Compensation Analyzer
tools.description: RSU vesting (cliff + graded), ISO/NSO intrinsic value, AMT flag, equity vs. cash equivalence, 3-offer total comp NPV stack. 2-tab. Legal disclaimer required.

tools.title: AI Skills Premium Calculator
tools.description: Calculate salary premium and NPV of AI skill acquisition by role, tool set, and labor market.

tools.title: Federal vs. Private Sector Comp Comparator
tools.description: Compare federal GS/SES compensation to private-sector equivalents including FERS pension and full benefits.

tools.title: Trade vs. Degree ROI Engine
tools.description: Model the NPV of trade apprenticeship versus four-year degree pathways by occupation and state.

tools.title: Remote Work Tax Mapper
tools.description: Identify state tax obligations, reciprocity agreements, and nexus risk for remote and hybrid workers.

tools.title: Non-Compete Risk & Enforceability Screener
tools.description: Screen non-compete clauses for enforceability risk by state law, role, and compensation threshold.

tools.title: Professional Degree ROI Ranker
tools.description: Rank MD, JD, MBA, and other professional degrees by tuition, opportunity cost, and lifetime earnings NPV.

tools.title: Military-to-Civilian Salary Bridge
tools.description: Convert military compensation (BAH, BAS, VA benefits) to civilian equivalent salary for job comparisons.

tools.title: Workforce Pell Eligibility Screener
tools.description: Estimates Workforce Pell Grant award for short-term credential programs (150-599 clock hours, 8-14 weeks) under OBBBA P.L. 119-21 (effective July 1, 2026). Inputs: AGI or SAI, family size, dependency status, clock hours, weeks, occupation category. Outputs: estimated SAI, base Pell eligibility, proration ratio, award, lifetime usage note.
tools.data_vintage: ED Pell Grant 2026-27; OBBBA P.L. 119-21 (July 4, 2025); Workforce Pell Final Rule (March 9, 2026)
regulatory_citations: ED Dear Colleague Letter 2026-01-30 — 2026-27 Pell max/min amounts
OBBBA P.L. 119-21 (July 4, 2025) — SAI cutoff expanded to $14,790
Federal Register 2026-04520 (March 9, 2026) — Workforce Pell Final Rule

tools.title: Workforce Pell Credential Value Ranker
tools.description: Ranks 21 Workforce Pell-eligible short-term credentials by ROI, wage gain, demand, and Pell coverage. Embeds BLS OEWS May 2023 wages and BLS OOH 2024-34 projections. Personalized to user SAI.

tools.title: Early Career Net Worth Trajectory Engine
tools.description: 10-year net worth projection for early-career individuals. Three savings scenarios (±10pp). Embedded 2026 tax brackets, 401k match, student debt paydown, SVG chart. Zero maintenance.
